title: Smoking-specific neutrophil information for lung-function prediction: an inconclusive cross-cycle test
abstract: Smoking-specific neutrophil interactions did not establish robust incremental prediction of pre-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC across NHANES cycles: weighted MSE difference -0.2438 pp² (joint PSU-bootstrap95% [-0.6134, 0.2775]); a simpler linear reference performed better than both primary models.
